title: Orchestration Terrace: rolling launch slate + capacity forecast for interleaved runtime/console/api releases
creator: Anika Patel
description: Create a single coordinated planning artifact (the 'Orchestration Terrace') that models overlapping runtime, console, and API launches on a shared weekly cadence, plus a rolling 12-week capacity forecast tuned for GPU/dedicated pools and burst lanes. Purpose: reduce last-minute conflicts, provide predictable capacity commitments for Dedicated customers, and define hard gating signals for model-impacting runtime changes.
milestones: Week 1: intake of planned runtime/console/api work for next 12 weeks
Week 2: capacity model run and preliminary GPU pool reservations
Week 3: stakeholder review and conflict resolution (PM/Eng/Platform/Sales)
Week 4: publish terrace slate + guardrail matrix and communication plan
Ongoing: weekly terrace sync and rolling reforecast
acceptance_criteria: Single terrace spreadsheet published with per-week owner, estimated throughput delta, and capacity lane assignment
Capacity forecast shows headroom/shortfall per region and per instance type for next 12 weeks
Gating rules documented for canary %s, fallback model variants, and rollback criteria
Stakeholder alignment sign-off from Runtime, Console, API, Sales (enterprise customers with Dedicated contracts)
notes: We should surface enterprise reserved capacity commitments to avoid overbooking Dedicated pools.
Consider a 'burst buffer' lane sized to absorb 10% of average weekly spike for Region us-west-2 and eu-west-1.
Trade-off: more aggressive reservation reduces spot capacity and increases cost; propose hybrid approach (soft reservations + spike-tiering).
risks: Late model onboarding that changes memory/latency profile and invalidates forecast
Regional infra incidents causing capacity ripples across terrace weeks
Lack of clear rollback ownership across runtime and console causes slow cutovers
communication_plan: Publish terrace snapshot to #launch-ops Slack and confluence page every Monday
Weekly 30-min terrace sync with representatives from Runtime, Console, API, Platform, and Sales
Automated digest to Dedicated customers when their reserved pool plans are impacted (email + account Slack)
Escalation matrix for capacity shortfalls documented on the terrace page
implementation_steps: 1) Assemble intake form and import script from Linear -> terrace spreadsheet
2) Run capacity simulation using current GA usage curves + expected delta for planned releases
3) Produce preliminary reservations and identify conflicts
4) Convene conflict resolution working session with Eng leads and Sales
5) Publish final terrace slate and enable weekly reforecast automation
metrics: % of launches that required emergency capacity increases (goal <5%)
Forecast accuracy (12-week) measured as absolute error in slots reserved vs consumed
